title: Recover backend subscriptions after a relay endpoint restart
intent: Bahia must reconnect a stale relay transport and reissue the same scoped subscriptions after an endpoint loss and recovery without restarting Bahia.
constraints: Use the shared relay pool rather than consumer-specific polling.
Preserve the original filters and event deduplication semantics.
Treat the underlying relay transport as authoritative connection state.
Report disconnected readiness until a replacement transport is connected.
